sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Plasma membrane localisation confirmed by imaging in HeLa cells (L2); outer-segment targeting confirmed in rod photoreceptors with OS/total intensity = 0.899 ± 0.063 (L5). No phototransduction or ligand-binding assay reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: Rhodopsin has no signal peptide (topology string contains no 'S'; residues 1–38 are all 'O'). The N-terminus is therefore the only extracellular terminus, and the FLAG tag described in L1/L2/L5 must sit there as a prepend (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M1). The extracellular span is 38 residues long, placing the junction 39 residues from TM1 (residue 39), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Python confirmed residue_after = 'M'. Full-length rhodopsin bearing an N-terminal FLAG tag (extracellular) and C-terminal GFP (intracellular) was expressed in HeLa cells (L1/L2) and in mouse rod photoreceptors via in vivo electroporation (L5). No signal peptide is present (raw topology begins O throughout residues 1–38), so the N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus; the tag must prepend before M1.

sources.claim: To monitor the trafficking of rhodopsin, we constructed fusion genes encoding chimeric rhodopsin proteins with a FLAG tag at their N-terminus (extracellular region) and green fluorescent protein (GFP) at their C-terminus (intracellular region; Fig. 1A ).

literature_notes: L3/L4 (Tag-RFP-T C-terminal knock-in), L6/L7 (1D4 epitope C-terminal), and L8 (Rho-GFP knock-in) all place tags at the intracellular C-terminus (residues 310–348, topology 'I') and are recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports a tolerated insertion in any extracellular loop (ECL1 96–111, ECL2 176–203, ECL3 274–285) of full-length membrane-anchored rhodopsin, so no internal extracellular sites are proposed. L5 is additional corroborating evidence for the N-terminal FLAG site already grounded in L1; L1 is cited as the primary supporting clip because it is the first and most explicit description of the construct design.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP fusion (after A348) confirmed at plasma membrane but faces the cytoplasm (intracellular topology 310–348); not a surface tag site.
C-terminal Tag-RFP-T knock-in (P23H hRho) after A348 is intracellular; expressed in rod photoreceptors but not on the extracellular face.
1D4 epitope tag (9 aa, TETSQVAPA) appended after A348 at the intracellular C-terminus; used for immunolabelling of permeabilised or fixed cells, not a surface epitope.
